name: Practice Guard's Grasp
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to jam the net or DC 25 Athletics check to knock the dummy over

items.name: Got You!
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the trap

---
Effect The creature must attempt a DC 23 Reflex save save or be Grabbed (Restrained on a critical failure). The DC to Escape is escape dc=23, or the net can be cut by doing 6 acid, fire, or slashing damage to it.

text: A spring-loaded net fires from the dummy, then is pulled tightly back in with magnets.
